descriptions.zh-Hans: 在阿克拉做的纸菜单，两块靠在一起的大蕉旁边留着花生的位置。
descriptions.en: My Accra paper menu leaves room for peanuts beside two joined pieces of plantain.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 吃过豆饭后做的菜单，袖口里的那一粒豆子也有了自己的小格子。
descriptions.en: A menu after rice and beans, including a tiny space for the bean that visited my cuff.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我记下努布克门前让路小事的自制纸折页，两扇纸翼可以错开。
descriptions.en: My homemade flaps remember making way at Nubuke; the paper wings can finally pass each other.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在图书馆外帮忙托书后折的纸角，折口留得比那本书薄。
descriptions.en: A corner I folded after helping with a book outside the library, much thinner than the volume itself.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在阿克拉剪的双层圆卡，掀开一层能看见藏在碗底的盖子。
descriptions.en: My two-layer paper disc from Accra reveals the lid that hid beneath my bowl.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我自己折的纸立卡，两只脚并在一起，包扣上没有多余的线。
descriptions.en: My folded standing messenger has feet together and a buckle free of loose thread.
